scope: Literal terminal readback of two fixed original 44d archives. This evidence records the bounded reader, existing Host observations and all original missing/failure denominators. It runs no native tests, grants no acceptance, changes no Host check, and does not qualify a10 or another source.

steps.name: Verify diagnostic source and original project boundary
Validate reader controls and read two exact original archives
Recheck unchanged diagnostic source and project boundary
Retain original ZIP bytes and all reader outcomes

precision_and_retention.literal_json: Every raw_json below is the exact timestamp-stripped JSON line emitted by the successful reader, retained as a string rather than parsed/reserialized original evidence. Full original report bytes remain in the output artifact.
precision_and_retention.source_literals: The diagnostic source-before and source-after JSON blocks are complete literal stdout. Original archived source guard console projections contain only their displayed fields; the reader validated the full selected source files and retained those bytes. The archive source files were not independently decompressed again during this terminal-log review.
precision_and_retention.numeric_summary: The human-readable phase summary is decoded from those exact reader lines. All displayed timing/counter values used here are nonnegative safe integers or null. Complete totals remain null for missing observations and for an empty History array.
precision_and_retention.artifact_scope: All four full native_host_projection JSON files, complete selected source/report JSON bytes, original ZIP files and member indexes are retained in the 24-file output artifact. This review read every compact console projection and all 52 displayed History rows; it did not redownload or decompress that output artifact.
precision_and_retention.clock_and_nesting: Host elapsed epochs differ from campaign/client epochs. Host CPU includes every invoking thread, including work-thread callers; it is not an exclusive fraction of caller-only or account_graph CPU. Nested import/graph/activation/Host intervals are not additive.
precision_and_retention.limits: No inference identifies per-file syscall, parser or fsync cost. No ABBA, p95, p99, throughput, 4-second target, independent WAN, production or whole-chain acceptance is derived from this Host readback.

empty_history_phases.scope: The original client History array is empty. This is not measured zero Host cost and is not evidence that no failure/cancellation occurred elsewhere.

known_checkpoint_subtotal.scope: Known subtotals from the 51 valid observed rows only; neither the unknown History row nor the empty-History phase is filled with zero.

confirmation.scope: These copy the reader's original per-phase confirmation observations. They do not establish a 4-second target or overall business acceptance.
